## Purpose and scope
Link the issue/task and approved behavior. Is this a starter change or app-specific work?

## Changes and reuse
Explain important choices, relevant existing solutions, and out-of-scope work.

## Validation evidence
List exact commands, tested revision/environment, PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN, and evidence.
Do not claim a generated app works because only starter tooling tests passed.

## Compatibility and risk
Describe affected contracts, migration/rollback, dependencies/licenses, security/privacy,
agent instructions/evaluators, and required independent review.

## Documentation and limitations
List changed guides/examples and known unrun checks or remaining issues.

## Contributor check
- [ ] I reviewed the entire diff, including agent-generated changes.
- [ ] No secrets, private intake, or unrelated user work is included.
- [ ] Tests and reviewers were not bypassed to manufacture approval.

## Specification reconciliation
What intended/actual behavior differs? Classify implementation defects, incorrect tests,
ambiguous requirements, new scope, and behavior-preserving refactors. Link approved material
amendments and separate current test evidence. Opted-in feature traceability must run through
the application CI profile; mapped missing/skipped release checks are not covered.
